residual_findings.title: KeyBlock body.state growth in SQLite body_json — document expectation + assess json_extract index need in P1 SqliteKbStore
residual_findings.scope: crates/nexus-local-db SqliteKbStore::query (P1 scope); schemas/domain/key-block.schema.json state field
residual_findings.note: No DB migration (body_json TEXT). Computable KeyBlocks accumulate mutable state over compute invocations. P1 should document body_json growth expectation and assess whether json_extract queries on computable need indexing. Not blocking for V1.61 additive rollout.
residual_findings.closure_note: Added §5.5.9.2.1 in entity-scope-model.md documenting SQLite body_json TEXT growth expectations for computable KeyBlocks: row size growth (per-module state schemas cap object sizes), DB file growth (SQLite WAL auto-checkpoints; VACUUM for bulk deletes), json_extract query cost (computable filter uses separate WHERE column, not json_extract; no state-path queries are a current pattern), and migration risk (TEXT column, graceful degradation on invalid JSON). No json_extract index needed at current scale (<10K computable KeyBlocks per world). Reassess at V2.0+ when user-authored modules introduce unbounded state shapes.

residual_findings.title: battle_report is freeform (additionalProperties: true) with no size guard — add runtime cap (e.g. 64 KB) in P3 apply path
residual_findings.note: V1 envelope design (compass Q8) intentionally freeform; module-declared fields. Runtime size guard belongs in P3 apply path, not schema (V2 may add per-kind shape enforcement).
residual_findings.closure_note: P3 addressed: BATTLE_REPORT_MAX_BYTES = 64 KB cap enforced in narrative_compute.rs apply path. Rejects oversized battle_report payloads.

residual_findings.title: Permissive placeholder schemas (item/faction/ability/species) — module manifest validation should declare expected shapes in P2/P3
residual_findings.note: Non-character BlockTypes use additionalProperties: true (intentional V1 placeholders). Runtime validation cost is deferred to module contract enforcement (manifest.json). P2/P3 should document that manifest declares BlockType + attribute/state shapes.
residual_findings.closure_note: Confirmed closed — §5.5.9.3 and §5.5.9.4 in entity-scope-model.md already document that V1.62 deleted the placeholder entity-attributes/entity-state schemas and replaced them with per-module manifest.json schemas blocks. Module authors declare per-BlockType attribute/state shapes in manifest.json (see compute-module-abi.md §7.3). The placeholder schemas are intentionally permissive; structured validation is deferred to module contract enforcement at compute invocation time.

residual_findings.title: BlockType enum does not include `environment` — P0 entity-attributes/state schemas substituted valid combat-relevant types (character/item/faction/ability/species)
residual_findings.note: Compass §1.1 P0 T3/T4 named `environment` as a computable BlockType, but `environment` is not a BlockType enum value. P0 substituted character (fully specified) + item/faction/ability/species (permissive placeholders). P1 must confirm the canonical computable BlockType set when wiring the local KeyBlockBody fields.
residual_findings.closure_note: Documented intentional exclusion in entity-scope-model.md §5.1.1. 'environment' is too broad for a single entity BlockType — it spans weather, terrain, celestial, ambient conditions, and multi-entity spatial state. Environmental context uses existing types: scene (spatial), event (ambient), info_point (rules). Per-profile body.attributes shapes (e.g. game-bible 'level' carrying terrain grid) provide domain-specific modelling. Module authors declare per-BlockType shapes in manifest.json schemas (§5.5.9.3). Future domain-specific environmental BlockType (e.g. 'biome') should follow the V1.54 game-bible precedent.
